holds.finding: Management API and the new Agent hub_url are pinned to repair:18080, but the actual ArtifactURL sent in DesiredState is built from Hub SyncManager.baseURL. The harness neither verifies the effective Hub base_url nor inspects the synced ArtifactURL host/port. The code default is localhost:8080 and YAML can override it. Agent Prefetch sends X-NodeSteer-Agent-Token to that URL. Therefore the strict repair-only artifact-download authority is not proven; a misconfigured base_url could target a different endpoint.
holds.required_before_execution: Provide a read-only preflight proving effective ArtifactURL scheme/host/port is exactly repair:18080, or add a safe guard that validates the synced URL host/port before any prefetch test. Do not run while this is unresolved.

holds.finding: Recovery does not tolerate an already-completed API deletion. The wrapper drops outer.delete_exact’s allow_missing option; recover() first requires GET 200 for each known App/Artifact/Node ID. If DELETE succeeded but the controller lost the response or stopped before saving the ledger, the next recovery sees GET 404 and aborts instead of recognizing exact absence and continuing the remaining cleanup. This leaves partial cleanup unrecoverable through the provided recovery path.
holds.required_before_execution: Make recovery reconcile exact GET 404 as already deleted for the ledger-pinned ID, then still verify final GET404 and collection/name absence; keep normal delete guards strict.

holds.finding: Cleanup mutates Docker/filesystem before the owner ledger records each removal. If interrupted after `docker rm`/`network rm` but before `atomic_owner`, retry inspects the stale recorded ID and stops rather than reconciling exact absence. Root cleanup also unlinks state/owner ledger files before removing the root; interruption after resource-ledger or owner.json removal makes load_state fail, so the recovery helper cannot resume. These are narrow but real crash windows in the recovery path.
holds.required_before_execution: Make cleanup phases restartable from exact nonce path/immutable IDs and preserve sufficient owner proof until root removal is complete; prove already-absent owned resources are reconciled without touching unowned objects.

overall_assessment: The prefetch/SQLite A-to-B test design and runtime identity checks are otherwise well-scoped and real (no Mock), with six normal and four recovery helper slots. Static admission remains HOLD until the three high-priority authority/recovery gaps are resolved and the resulting source hashes are reviewed.
